name: Jolly to Whimsy-san
original_name: ジョリーとウィムジーさん
source:
✨ Join Jolly on a magical journey! ✨

When her best friend, Whimsy the cat, suddenly returns to the Cat Planet, Jolly will try any spell to bring him back. 

[From [url=https://mondaymocha.itch.io/jollyandwhimsy]itch.io[/url]]
